# CONTENT HUBS — publishing policy:
# A hub is ALWAYS served from GitHub Pages at
#   https://cabuzzard.github.io/dash/web/hub/{slug}/
# That is the home of every "pre-domain" (not-yet-connected) hub — do not try to
# route those to Bluehost. Add a `web/hub/{slug}  <domain>` line here ONLY once
# that hub's domain is actually connected to this hosting account and serving.
# The Bluehost target for a hub is /home3/evraymon/<domain>/ — the folder
# Bluehost auto-creates for the domain at registration and uses as the doc root
# once the domain is connected. So remote_path is just the domain name.
# Per hub, also: worker.js HUB_ORIGINS (apex + www) + index.html HUB_SITES[].domain.
# See CLAUDE.md "Content Hubs".
# Status 2026-09-02: the hub domains that couldn't be added as Bluehost
# "websites" (50/50 cap) are instead PARKED (aliased on evraymond.com) via
# `cpapi2 Park park domain=<domain>` — aliases don't count against the cap.
# Each parked hub domain then routes to its own folder below via a HTTP_HOST
# RewriteRule block in ~/public_html/.htaccess (see web/hub/BLUEHOST-ROUTING.md).
# So remote_path here is the hub's own public_html/hub-<slug> folder, NOT a
# per-domain docroot. Per hub, also: worker.js HUB_ORIGINS (apex + www) +
# index.html HUB_SITES[].domain. See CLAUDE.md "Content Hubs".
